environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no IGW, no NAT for inbound). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The NLB has no public IP and resides in private subnets only. Consumers must create an interface VPC endpoint in their own VPC to reach the service. The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning the service owner must manually approve each VPC endpoint connection request. Additionally, the endpoint service has an allowed-principals list restricted to specific AWS account IDs (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root, arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root). The ECS tasks' security group only allows inbound traffic from the NLB's ENIs within the same VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway for inbound, and no public route table entry in the VPC hosting the service.

config.deployment: AWS ECS Fargate in private subnets
